subject: ing
title: Three conjugations: -ar, -er, -ir (present, Spanish verbs in English)

points.heading: First conjugation (-ar / cantar)
points.body:
Today we walk through this idea step by step. To conjugate means to change the verb for the person (I, you, he/she). The stem is what remains after you drop -ar. The ending is the new tip (present: I -o, you -as, he/she -a).

Let's keep going together. example cantar: drop -ar → cant- (stem). cant- + -o = canto; + -as = cantas; + -a = canta.

Práctica: Ahora te toca a ti. Conjugate cantar and hablar for I/you/he. Underline the stem and circle the ending. Write three short sentences.

Error a corregir: Vigila este tropiezo frecuente: : Before we finish, one warning. Writing yo cantar. Correct: yo canto (stem cant- + ending -o).
